title: Remove unused GitSettingsModal (no caller since #396)
summary: Deleted the unused Git settings dialog and its export; no user-visible change, no new tests.

deferred.why: Out of scope: the issue chose delete over re-wiring (reversible; the file is recoverable from 7098033).
